name: Love in the Time of Spellphage
source:
Lauren is a conjuration junior at Crowstone Wizard's University who is bored and alone in the early weeks of pandemic lockdown. Unsure of what to do with her career after graduation, she faces a decision that will change the course of her life. Help to guide her through two days of isolation that could alter history itself — or not, if she doesn't feel like it.

[From [url=https://sophiefromhowls.itch.io/love-in-the-time-of-spellphage-01]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
劳伦是克劳斯通巫师大学的一名咒法三年级学生，在大流行封锁的最初几周，她感到无聊和孤独。她不确定毕业后该做什么，她面临着一个将改变她人生轨迹的决定。帮助引导她度过两天的隔离期，这可能会改变历史本身——也可能不会，如果她不喜欢的话。

[来自[url=https://sophiefromhowls.itch.io/love-in-the-time-of-spellphage-01]itch.io[/url]]
